intro: Copper makes up most of Zambia's exports.

chapters.title: Copper
text: Zambia is one of Africa's top copper producers, essential for electric wiring. Cobalt is also mined. The TAZARA railway, built with Chinese help, links Zambia to Tanzania's coast.

chapters.title: Power
text: Droughts have cut hydropower from Kariba, causing long power cuts.
